publication.title: Covid-on-the-Web: Exploring the COVID-19 scientific literature through visualization of linked data from entity and argument mining
publication.version: 2021 HAL author manuscript of QSS article

source_reading.scope: Abstract/contributions, RDF-model excerpts, complete interface architecture (§4), selected use-case workflow (§5.1), discussion (§6) and future work.

adjudication.basis: LDViz implements querying and chained visual exploration of linked RDF literature/entity/argument data, with parameterized templates, subset views and exploration history. It supplies use-case demonstrations; user-based usability evaluation is explicitly future work.

backend.source_model_description: {"data_model": "RDF and SPARQL", "components": ["MGExplorer", "SPARQL JSON transformation engine", "Entity-fishing", "ACTA", "Optional Corese services"], "constraint": "Queries must provide defined node/document variables (?s/?o/?p or ?author); edge-type representation groups above four values into three frequent types plus Other."}

descriptions.evaluation: Five use-case scenarios demonstrating domain-query resolution; no completed recruited user evaluation established.
